item.title: Walker Valley Racks up 19 Steals in Beating Bradley Central 66-36
item.description: Cleveland, TN-(WDEF-TV) Walker Valley put on a defensive clinic against Bradley Central racking up 19 steals in beating the Bears 66-36. Zach Davis led the Mustangs attack with 5 steals and 18-points. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: CCS Guard Jack Fox Proving to be a Chip Off the Old Block
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Chattanooga Christian guard Jack Fox is one of the top scorers in town, averaging nearly 30-points a game. He’s doing it all while playing for his father, who also had a knack for putting the ball in the basket during his playing days at Notre Dame. Brian Armstrong reports.
